subject: Primary-source reconstruction of the LPB definitive texts and liquidation baseline in Concurso 36/2012
verified_findings: The 2016 filing expressly modified the inventory, creditor list and report and elevated the prior report to definitive status except where expressly modified.
The principal 2016 tables record active EUR 19,486,498.94 and passive EUR 10,125,752.00.
The separate definitive creditor list records EUR 9,052,251.69 of special privilege.
The two quantified special-privilege entries are EUR 857,373.81 and EUR 8,194,877.88.
The 8 February 2018 order substitutes CAM as holder at those recognised amounts.
The liquidation plan expressly relies on the inventory made definitive.
The plan identifies 159 apartments, 29 premises and two pool/solarium properties as LPB's real-estate inventory.
traceability_questions: principal 2016 tables versus materially different figures in a later paragraph
1 February 2011 report reference versus the controlled 15 January 2013 LPB report
28 April filing date versus 29 April electronic signature
three-cent table/list differences in ordinary and subordinated totals
express_exclusions: no automatic treatment of mortgage caps or later accruals as definitive insolvency credit
no automatic cancellation of later rights
no criminality, bad faith or misconduct finding
no inclusion of Matkator or third-party property in LPB's estate without property-specific proof
no publication of raw PDFs, signatures, identifiers or private source-system references
open_evidence: complete court-certified definitive-text bundle and docket index
filing receipt and decision receiving/joining the definitive texts
2022-02-21 credit calculation and legal basis for each component
final accounts, ledger, bank trail, liquidation balance and conclusion record
